name: Formosa Optical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Formosa Optical Technology Co.,Ltd. is a dedicated supplier of vision care products across Taiwan. Their diverse portfolio features corrective eyewear such as prescription glasses and sunglasses, alongside a variety of contact lenses, including both clear and colored options. Additionally, the firm furnishes professional optometry equipment. The company, which was established in 1976, conducts its operations from its primary office located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
